title: Consolidating Gift Cards & Store Credit Card Balances
content:
A Gift Cards & Store Credit consolidation names at least the minimum number of active instruments that the instrument type sets for a consolidation, all of a type that allows consolidation, one of them an instrument of the type that receives consolidated balances, which the holder names as the receiving card. The holder's own confirmation records the consolidation request for both cards as confirmed and moves the consolidation amount off the other card onto the receiving card, and the other card closes with reason consolidated once nothing is left on it.

## Basis

The consolidation amount is not worked out until the stolen or lost card's ledger carries the replacement transfer-out entry naming the card that took over its protected value.

## Business effect

| Card | After the confirmed consolidation |
|---|---|
| The other (moving) card | A transfer entry naming the receiving card, for the consolidation amount; closed with reason consolidated when nothing is left on it, otherwise active with the remaining value |
| The receiving card | A consolidation load naming the moving card, for the consolidation amount; balance raised by it |
| Both cards | A confirmed consolidation request on each |

## Action: `confirm_card_consolidation_106a95bf`

**Capability.** The holder personally confirms combining value from one of their own stored-value cards onto another of their own cards. One call records the holder's confirmed consolidation request for both cards, moves the amount confirmed off the source card (a transfer entry naming the receiving card) and onto the receiving card (a consolidation load naming the source card), and updates both balances; the source card is closed as consolidated when nothing is left on it, and otherwise stays active with the remaining value.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own action: the agent unlocks `confirm_card_consolidation_106a95bf` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to give their confirmation.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `source_instrument_id` | The reference number of the holder's card the value moves off, as read out to the holder from the stored-value instrument lookup | Id |
| `receiving_instrument_id` | The reference number of the holder's card that receives the value, as read out to the holder from the stored-value instrument lookup | Id |
| `consolidation_usd` | The amount moved between the two cards | A positive amount in USD with 2 decimal places, for example 64.10 |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the confirmed request references, the transfer entry and the consolidation load references, the amount moved in USD with 2 decimal places, and the new balances of the source and receiving cards in USD with 2 decimal places with the source card's status (closed when nothing remains, otherwise active). The presence of the load reference means the consolidation was confirmed and booked.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

Run by the customer themselves with a Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card holding 85.20 as the source, another e-Gift Card holding 10.00 as the receiving card and 64.10, the action leaves the source card active with 21.10 and the receiving card with 74.10.
